title: PVP-functionalized Dy2O3/Pr2O3 nanocomposites: a multifunctional platform for photoluminescence, WLEDs, latent fingerprinting, and anti-counterfeiting applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35553-35565
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06661A, Paper
Open Access

Kartik Gopal, Sunitha D. V.
PVP-coated Dy2O3/Pr2O3 nanocomposites exhibit intense warm-white luminescence and enable clear latent fingerprint visualization, demonstrating multifunctional potential for WLEDs, forensics, and anti-counterfeiting applications.
